meta.description: The cross-linguistic positions of polar question particles and complementizers, from features 92A and 94A of the World Atlas of Language Structures. A language counts as initial or final for each head; the four combinations are the two consistent orders, an initial complementizer over a final particle (the inverse of the final-over-final configuration) and a final complementizer over an initial particle (the final-over-final configuration).

types.name: Position
types.doc: The position of a head in its phrase.

tables.name: polarityComplementizer
tables.doc: the languages with each combination of the positions of the polar question particle and the complementizer.
